Cracking it open, she pulled out a water-stained note scrawled in shaky ink, dated 1927: ‘If you find this, the light still burns, and I am not forgotten.’ She knelt for a long moment, tucking the note into her coat before climbing back up the lighthouse steps, already planning to leave a new note inside the bottle for the next keeper decades from now.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市褪去了白日的喧嚣，柏油路面还留着白日余热散后的微凉。沿街的路灯晕着暖黄的光，零星的晚归人踩着拉长的影子走过，早点铺的蒸笼刚刚冒起第一缕白汽，远处环卫工人的扫帚声轻得怕惊扰了睡梦中的人，偶有夜风卷着落叶擦过街角，整座城像沉在半醒半眠的软梦里，等第一班公交驶过才会慢慢醒转。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a tiny, identical version of the same problem helps solve the bigger problem, like opening a nested stack of wrapped birthday presents.\n- It always has a simple stopping point, like when you reach the smallest present that doesn’t hold another box inside.\n- Every step moves you closer to that stopping point, so you never get stuck opening the same box over and over forever."}
